messages:
jamie_cs: quick flag 9 BlueQuarry renewal ready but procurement returned PO `BF-900` for "BlueQuarry Ltd (UK)" while contract is for "BlueQuarry, Inc. (US)". internal docusign: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-7782 :confused:

 tom_sales: just spoke w/ Ava. procurement says UK entity required for local billing. they can reissue but expect 2-4 business days. customer offered to pay first invoice by CC so we can kick off onboarding. wants to e-sign now and swap invoice entity later.

 priya_legal: legal note 1 not ideal to sign with mismatched entity. revenue will block invoice. we can accept if we add a one-paragraph amendment obligating customer to deliver corrected PO within 30 days and grant us right to suspend if absent. need vendor code + tax id on reissued PO.

 ops-liaison: ops note > we can run onboarding tasks that don't require billing. license activation and SSO provisioning require cleared billing. CC payment for month1 lets us activate. manual pro-forma invoice possible but finance will require ticket.

 jamie_cs: customer ok to CC for month1 and to provide card details via secure payment link. plan: A) collect CC for month1, send envelope with amendment placeholder, accept reissued PO later. B) wait for PO reissue and sign then. which?

 tom_sales: i'll confirm vendor code and VAT number, ping procurement to reissue PO. will post updates here.

 finance-bot: NOTICE: invoices where billing entity != contract entity will be queued for review. Manual override requires finance approval ticket (ref FIN-4821).

 priya_legal: i'll draft the amendment now. suggested clause: "Customer shall deliver corrected PO referencing original order within 30 days; failure to provide may result in invoice hold and service suspension." short and explicit.

 jamie_cs: please add vendor code field to envelope and require a CFO signer checkbox for the amendment. i'll send envelope in ~20m. fallback: scanned wet-sign accepted if they push back.

 docusign-bot: Envelope env-7782 created by jamie_cs. status: awaiting signatures. reminder scheduled in 48h.

 tom_sales: once signed i'll process CC for month1 and update this thread with payment receipt. :thumbsup:
